jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote - US About the Job: LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As a GTM AI Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the AI-powered systems that make our sales, marketing, customer success, and partnerships teams more effective. You will sit at the intersection of engineering and revenue. You’ll turn messy go-to-market workflows into reliable, measurable automation, such as agents that research accounts, tools that surface buying signals, and pipelines that keep our data trustworthy. You’ll work directly with GTM stakeholders to find high-leverage problems, ship quickly, and prove impact with data. Responsibilities: Design and build LLM-powered agents and workflows for use cases like account research, lead and account prioritization, outbound personalization, call summarization, deal inspection, renewal risk detection, and customer health insights. Focus on end user experience to optimize delivery of content, process adherence and tool utilization Integrate AI systems with the GTM stack (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Marketo, Slack, Zoom, data warehouse, and enrichment providers). Build and maintain data pipelines that unify product usage, CRM, marketing, and support data into reliable inputs for models and agents. Partner with Sales, Marketing, CS, and RevOps leaders to translate business problems into technical solutions, and prioritize by revenue impact and effort. Establish evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring for AI outputs, covering accuracy, hallucination rates, cost, latency, and adoption.
